sections.heading: Esports rooms for cities and community programs.
sections.headingHtml: Esports rooms for cities and community programs.
sections.lede: We build esports rooms for nonprofits, government agencies, and community organizations, and we plan each one around the people you serve.

images.alt: Players in matching shirts celebrating at a row of gaming stations

sections.heading: For every kind of community organization.
sections.lede: Rec centers, youth groups, churches, and job training programs each need something different. We plan around your space and your mission.

cards.title: Nonprofits & Youth Organizations
cards.subtitle: Programs that keep young people coming back.
cards.body: Boys & Girls Clubs, YMCAs, and after-school programs use esports to give young people a structured, positive place to be. We build the room and help connect your program to grants that support your mission.

cards.title: Government & Municipal
cards.subtitle: Public rooms the whole community can use.
cards.body: City recreation centers, libraries, and municipal buildings can use GSA and DIR contracts to build esports spaces open to the public. We’ve done it before and know the process.

cards.title: Faith-Based Organizations
cards.subtitle: A way to reach youth where they already are.
cards.body: Churches and faith-based community centers are finding esports to be one of the most effective tools for youth outreach. We build right-sized rooms that fit your space and your values.

cards.title: Workforce Development
cards.subtitle: Digital skills, taught through games.
cards.body: Job training centers and reentry programs use esports to teach digital literacy, IT fundamentals, and career skills. We build the room and connect you to curriculum partners who support the work.

cards.title: Not sure where to start?
cards.body: Answer a few questions about your space and program, and we’ll send you a free readiness report.

faqs.q: Are there grants available to fund an esports facility for a nonprofit?
faqs.a: Yes. Federal, state, and private grants for youth development, digital access, and workforce readiness can fund esports facilities. We help you find and apply for the ones that fit your organization.

faqs.q: Can government agencies use cooperative purchasing contracts like GSA or DIR?
faqs.a: Yes. DIR, GSA, OMNIA, and NCPA cooperative contracts give government agencies, municipalities, and qualifying nonprofits a compliant way to buy without a separate bid.

faqs.q: Is the environment safe for youth programs?
faqs.a: Yes. Enterprise cybersecurity is standard on every build, so rooms serving youth are safe, monitored, and compliant.

faqs.q: Do we need technical staff to manage the facility after it’s built?
faqs.a: No. Our managed services cover lab operations, monitoring, and IT support after the build, so your team can focus on the program.

faqs.q: Can our organization participate in the TANCHES.GG League?
faqs.a: Yes. The League brings structured competition to community organizations, from a single location to a whole network of centers.

faqs.q: What if our budget is limited? Can we start small?
faqs.a: Yes. We scope to what you need, and grants, leasing, and manufacturer co-funding can help offset the cost.
